cohort: Pregnant women of any gravidity with singleton pregnancy, vertex presentation, well-flexed and engaged head, fully dilated cervix, and ruptured membranes, with indications to hasten delivery, excluding those with severe intrauterine growth retardation, intrauterine fetal death, congenital abnormalities, suspected fetal coagulopathy, macrosomia, pelvic soft tissue obstruction, severe vaginal/cervical infection, or unwillingness to participate.
finding: Ventouse delivery is generally safe for both mothers and newborns, although mild to moderate complications can occur.
